recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-47291 unless the work group specifically wants exact Jira wording instead of the current equivalent wording.
issue_request: FHIR-47291 was Applied with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested replacing the Subscription $status operation description so the operation gets current status information about topic-based Subscriptions as described by the SubscriptionStatus resource.
initial_application: The issue was previously applied by commit 3b84a2183564bbdb4b6a6252f245655a9cd823b5, which changed source/subscription/operationdefinition-Subscription-status.xml from generic current status information to current status information for topic-based Subscriptions, each described by a SubscriptionStatus resource. That commit is an ancestor of the combined branch but did not include an Issue-Reconcile-Key trailer.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists subscription=Subscription and subscriptionstatus=SubscriptionStatus, confirming the OperationDefinition source is in current build scope. FHIR-I minutes for 2025-03-31 record FHIR-47291 in the Subscriptions block vote with 17-0-0 approval, Jira later linked HL7/fhir PR 3967, and gh showed PR 3967 merged as the R6 Tickets PR. Zulip search found the block vote announcement and no conflicting technical discussion. Related FHIR-47292 concerns the same $status operation return documentation and already has its own reconciliation commit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope OperationDefinition description already preserves the applied resolution's implementer-facing meaning by identifying SubscriptionStatus as the resource describing each status result.

related_jiras.note: Same Subscription $status operation return documentation family; it was encountered during source/history checks and already has a separate Issue-Reconcile-Key commit on the combined branch.
